I teach government and public policy at Hamilton College.

I'm from Oklahoma. I went to Hendrix College and did my PhD at UNC-Chapel Hill.

I've always got a new hobby going. The two that stuck are record collecting and
rock climbing. I also tinker with computers more than I probably should.
